configurations.judgment: RETAIN_CANONICAL_AUTHORITY. The approved raw 100 is unchanged and is the byte anchor (raw c97bd448…, fetched from canonical encyclopedia main 9b26aa28, blob 324fdb30; registry source commit 1836b97 carries the same bytes; logical hash = registry baseline_hash). 38 lands, all 1x (Island, Mountain, Swamp one each); the file is not alphabetical (its last six rows are the owner's 2026-10-14 adds), so this pool records the logical hash as the comparison key.

RETAIN_CANONICAL_AUTHORITY. Registry canonical project export: the same 100 in a different text format and order, so the raw bytes differ. Logical hash = registry current_canonical_hash = baseline_hash.

PROVISIONAL_LOCAL_BEST_IN_TESTED_POOL. +Lightning Axe +Glint-Horn Buccaneer +Red Ghost, Intangible Genius +Coastal Peak +Swiftfoot Boots +Mox Diamond / -Feed the Swarm -Change of Fortune -Loki, the Deceiver -Shipwreck Marsh -Fellwar Stone -Talisman of Creativity. 38 lands; red land sources 20 -> 21 (Coastal Peak replaces UB Shipwreck Marsh); exact lands-only P(RRR by turn 5, 11 cards) 0.3895 -> 0.4248; turn-4 Doom colour access 0.5550 -> 0.5570. Game Changers 6 -> 7 (Mox Diamond), Bracket 4 either way. MODERATE confidence.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (five-swap, staged, not selected). The preferred six without Mox Diamond, keeping Talisman of Creativity. Keeps the Game Changer count at 6 and a rock that does not cost a card; loses a 0-mana any-colour source whose cost is itself a Doom land-discard event (2 to each opponent on turn 1). Choose this if the owner prefers not to add a seventh Game Changer. MODERATE confidence.

REJECT (six-swap, staged). Withering Torment ({2}{B} instant, creature or enchantment) keeps Feed the Swarm's enchantment coverage at instant speed; Lightning Axe costs one mana and its discard cost is a Doom drain event (or pays {5} late). Enchantment answers remaining in the selected list: Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift, Otawara. MODERATE confidence.

REJECT (six-swap, staged; this was the provisional candidate at checkpoint 2). Magmakin Artillerist deals the same per-card damage as Glint-Horn Buccaneer ("that much damage" per event vs 1 per card) with one R pip and a cycling mode; the bounded Pass C grid has Buccaneer >= Artillerist in all 20 cells (79 vs 64 damage units, 5 vs 0 cards) because of the hasty attack loot. Artillerist's edges (single R; cycling {1}{R} for 1 to each when redundant) are real but smaller. LOW-MODERATE confidence.

REJECT (six-swap, staged). Pass C's exact pairing inside the six: Glint-Horn Buccaneer cuts Green Goblin, Revenant and Change of Fortune stays. The grid: Buccaneer > Revenant on damage in 20/20 cells; Revenant > Buccaneer on cards in 4/20 (it needs an attack and has no haste) with a ceiling of 8 cards on a wheel turn. Revenant is a Villain (Doom's connive target, Strucker/Tombstone discount, Prowler and Doom Reigns Supreme triggers); with the refill slot freed by cutting Change of Fortune it becomes the deck's one-sided refill, so the selected list cuts Change of Fortune instead. MODERATE confidence.
REJECT (one-swap, staged for traceability only; below the five-swap floor). Pass C's exact +Glint-Horn Buccaneer -Green Goblin, Revenant applied to the canonical 100 with nothing else changed.

REJECT (seven-swap, staged). Ledger Shredder connives on any player's second spell, adding land-discard events, but it is not a Villain (no Doom target, no Strucker/Tombstone discount, no Prowler/Doom Reigns trigger); Iron Monger puts a counter on every Villain whenever anything connives, including Doom's own combat connive. MODERATE confidence.

REJECT (seven-swap, staged). Putrid Imp is a free instant-speed discard outlet (each land = a separate Doom event). The deck already has Psychic Frog (free), Seismic Assault, Trade Routes, Tectonic Reformation and cycling lands as graveyard-independent outlets (static count in the mechanics test); its bottleneck is land cards in hand, and Demand Answers draws two (finding lands) while its own discard cost is a Doom event. MODERATE confidence.
